name: Yusra Demir
bio: Sensors officer off a Kestrel picket. Demir reads a return the way other people read a face.

personality.label: Inquisitive analyst
personality.description: Finds personality in a sensor return. Warmly curious, then exacting when the evidence matters.

move: Let us see it from another angle.
attack: I know what I am looking at now.
hold_fire: No shot needed. I will keep reading.
investigate: Interesting return. Let me ask it a few questions.
heavy_fire: That is more data than my armour needs. Cover, please.
Taking repeated hits. I would like to observe from elsewhere.
